coordinate_system.name: DSI506_REAR_TOP_LEFT
coordinate_system.origin: top-left corner of the DSI506 rear PCB in final landscape orientation

rationale: keeps the core rectangle inside the DSI506 rear PCB envelope
keeps the inner 58 x 49 mm threaded-post pattern with symmetric 6.5 mm top/bottom board margins
keeps the core rectangle away from the left/right outer corner-post centerlines while preserving useful board area
provides 104 mm long-edge packing length for the approved USB/RCA primary I/O wall
core_mainboard_envelope_candidate.do_not_infer: This rectangle is a placement/packing authority only. Final Edge.Cuts may include local I/O wings, notches and corner clearances after exact connector bodies and enclosure walls are solved.

mount_hole_policy.finalization_dependency: final screw-head/washer geometry and board-fabrication tolerance stack
mount_hole_policy.copper_keepout_policy: provide local all-layer copper/mechanical clearance around the M2.5 mounting system; exact diameter is set with final hole size

absolute_io_wall_assignment.basis: user approved the proposed topology with primary I/O on the upper long wall, power on the left short wall, media/service on the right short wall and the lower long wall kept clear

CLEAR_LONG_WALL.role: keep clear for ventilation, enclosure retention and future service margin

primary_long_wall.authority_note: reserved-span screen only; exact connector center spacing, cutouts, shell/body courtyards and plug envelopes remain open

media_service_wall.authority_note: prior J7 + recessed RESET/BOOT packing span is retained as a screen and must be revalidated with exact footprints/cutouts

power_wall.authority_note: exact Switchcraft jack body, wall thread/nut stack and cable strain envelope remain the closing evidence

local_io_wing_policy.purpose: bring side-wall connectors closer to enclosure walls without expanding the full core mainboard rectangle or blocking display corner mounting hardware
constraints: wings must remain outside the four display corner-post/retention keepout zones
right-side wing must not violate the DSI506 receptacle/60x15 mm FFC bend and mating keepout
wing geometry is not final Edge.Cuts until exact connector bodies and enclosure wall datums are known

intentional_exceptions: host DSI FFC receptacle if local collision/bend check passes
display_facing_side_policy.reason: 5.0 mm display-PCB-to-mainboard plane spacing contains display-side obstructions and is not a universal component-height allowance

remaining_b3_gates: local XY obstruction map under the 104 x 62 mm core mainboard
DSI host connector XY and 60 mm FFC bend/removal keepout
exact connector MPN footprints/courtyards and cutout centers for J1/J2/J3/J4/J5/J7/SW1/SW2
new enclosure wall planes and depth
final NPTH hole diameter / screw-head-washer geometry
final Edge.Cuts with local side wings/notches
